summary: The scaled joint ledger has pointwise density at most one, and the fiberwise metronoid argument correctly supplies the additional factor gamma_d needed for both halfspace dominations, including proper, whole, empty, boundary, and zero-selected-mass cases. The exact masses, all rational lower bounds, and both normalized rank screens are arithmetically and logically correct; positive rescaling preserves the intrinsic ranks and the accepted parent-child identity applies unchanged. The two convex-order comparisons admit the stated finite martingale couplings, with repeated or coincident atoms handled by aggregation, and they imply the affine-support inclusions. The scaled replacement subledger defines the asserted mixed density, its mass and full first moment are exact, and packetwise Jensen plus nonnegativity gives precisely the limited inequalities claimed. The proof makes none of the excluded targetwise, integrality, selector, or terminal assertions.
